title: Schwarz: Solver-Aware Agentic Program Verification
abstract: arXiv:2608.30803v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agentic verification systems can often generate source-level specifications that look plausible, but plausibility is not enough: the verifier must still turn those specifications into SMT obligations that the solver can prove. When this step fails, current LLM-driven loops usually expose only a coarse verifier error, timeout, or unknown solver result. The model cannot tell whether the specification is wrong, a helper lemma is missing, the proof context contains irrelevant facts, or the obligation needs a different theory view. This paper presents Schwarz, an agentic verification harness that makes SMT-backed proof failure local, checkable, and repairable. Schwarz turns failed verification into obligation-local repair tasks: program-point snapshots expose checked facts at a boundary, local lemmas let the agent propose missing proof steps, and theory-aware solver policies guide the agent toward solver-friendly formulations for numeric, q

translated_title: Schwarz：求解器感知的智能体程序验证
translated_abstract: 智能体验证系统通常能够生成看起来合理的源代码级规范，但仅凭合理性是不够的：验证器仍必须将这些规范转化为求解器能够证明的SMT证明义务。当这一步失败时，当前由LLM驱动的循环通常只会暴露粗粒度的验证器错误、超时或未知的求解器结果。模型无法判断究竟是规范本身有误、缺少辅助引理、证明上下文中包含无关事实，还是该义务需要从不同的理论视角来表述。本文提出了Schwarz，一个智能体验证框架，它使基于SMT的证明失败变得局部化、可检查且可修复。Schwarz将失败的验证转化为义务局部的修复任务：程序点快照暴露边界处已检查的事实，局部引理让智能体能够提出缺失的证明步骤，而理论感知的求解器策略则引导智能体为数值、量词等场景找到求解器友好的表述方式。
tldr: Schwarz是一个求解器感知的智能体程序验证框架，通过程序点快照、局部引理和理论感知的求解器策略，将基于SMT的证明失败转化为局部化、可检查且可修复的义务级修复任务。
en_tdlr: Schwarz is a solver-aware agentic verification harness that turns SMT-backed proof failures into obligation-local, checkable, and repairable tasks by combining program-point snapshots, local lemmas, and theory-aware solver policies.
